mentions.name: Bloom
mentions.description: This open source Android app provides org-mode-compatible note-taking and task management. Features include capture templates with app shortcuts, sync conflict notifications with revision-picking or merging resolution, a customizable agenda showing overdue, due soon, and upcoming events, quick task adding from the agenda widget overlay, task refiling by drilling into files/headings or searching, auto-archiving of done tasks, and org-attach-compliant attachments with inline image rendering and configurable width.
mentions.problem: The author experienced friction with the existing org-mode Android app Orgzly Revived and built their own.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building Bloom, an open source Android app for note-taking and task management that's compatible with org-mode.

I was experiencing some friction with Orgzly Revived and thought I'll build my own and it just grew.
mentions.author: rrajath
